![Image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/441114/description_0d1b08a3-1170-4e73-acd6-bd46783da875.png)
《Neko's Enchanted Books》是一款適用於 Forge 的小型模組，為原版 Minecraft 中的每一本附魔書增添了獨特的紋理！

此外，該模組還與以下內容相容：

- Advent of Ascension 3
- Alex's Mobs
- Allurement
- Apotheosis
- BetterDefaultBiomes
- BetterEnd (Forge)
- Big Brain
- Brooms
- Charm
- Corpse Complex
- Create
- Elenai Dodge 2
- Ensorcellation
- Farmer's Delight
- Fins and Tails
- Greed N' Bleed
- Jellyfishing
- Locks
- Ma Enchants
- Mining Master
- Momentum
- Seeker's Compass
- Shulker Enchantments
- Step, Leap, Dash
- Supplementaries
- VanillaTweaks
- Veinmining
- Wall-Jump!
- Wonderful Enchantments

如果您希望增加更多相容性，歡迎自行 Fork 該專案，並將 PR 提交至我的 GitHub！https://github.com/CGessinger/Nekos-Enchanted-Books

CurseForge 鏡像站：https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/nekos-enchanted-books
